call.transcript:
Agent: Hi Priya, this is Maya calling from Bloom Salon about your haircut on Thursday at 9 in the morning. Does that still work for you?
User: Actually no, Thursday morning is bad for me now.
Agent: No problem. I have Thursday at four in the afternoon, or Friday at eleven.
User: Four on Thursday is perfect.
Agent: Lovely, you're booked for Thursday at four in the afternoon. See you then!
User: Thanks, bye.
